```{r libs}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(clusterCrit)
library(FPDclustering)
```

# Create cashed and plot folders
```{r dirs}
dir.create("output/fpdc_cache", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/fpdc_plots", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("output/fpdc_results", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 1. Embedding files and tuning ranges
```{r}
embedding_paths <- c(
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_64.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_128.csv",
  "output/embeddings/user_embeddings_256.csv"
)

# Smaller grid is safer for FPDC
k_range <- 2:5
q_range <- 2:4

all_results <- list()

```

# 2 Fit embeddings with caching
```{r caching}

start_time <- Sys.time()

for (embedding_path in embedding_paths) {
  
  if (!file.exists(embedding_path)) {
    cat("Missing file:", embedding_path, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  cat("\nProcessing:", embedding_path, "\n")
  
  embeddings <- read_csv(embedding_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  user_ids <- embeddings[[1]]
  embedding_matrix <- embeddings[, -1]
  embedding_matrix <- scale(as.matrix(embedding_matrix))
  
  embedding_tag <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(embedding_path))
  
  full_cache_file <- file.path(
    "output/fpdc_cache",
    paste0("fpdc_full_result_", embedding_tag, ".rds")
  )
  
  # Prefer loading full saved result
  if (file.exists(full_cache_file)) {
    cat("Loading full cached result for:", embedding_tag, "\n")
    all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- readRDS(full_cache_file)
    next
  }
  
  dmat <- dist(embedding_matrix)
  
  results_grid <- expand.grid(k = k_range, q = q_range)
  results_grid$Silhouette <- NA_real_
  results_grid$CH <- NA_real_
  results_grid$ProbSilh <- NA_real_
  
  total_jobs <- nrow(results_grid)
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = total_jobs, style = 3)
  
  fpdc_models <- vector("list", nrow(results_grid))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_grid))) {
    
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
    
    k_val <- results_grid$k[i]
    q_val <- results_grid$q[i]
    
    cache_file <- file.path(
      "output/fpdc_cache",
      paste0("fpdc_", embedding_tag, "_k", k_val, "_q", q_val, ".rds")
    )
    
    if (file.exists(cache_file)) {
      cat("Loading cached result for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "q =", q_val, "\n")
      cached <- readRDS(cache_file)
      model <- cached$model
      avg_sil <- cached$Silhouette
      ch_val <- cached$CH
      prob_sil <- cached$ProbSilh
    } else {
      cat("Running FPDC for", embedding_tag, "k =", k_val, "q =", q_val, "\n")
      
      model <- FPDC(
        embedding_matrix,
        k_val,
        20,
        q_val
      )
      
      labels <- model$label
      
      sil <- silhouette(labels, dmat)
      avg_sil <- mean(sil[, 3])
      
      ch_val <- intCriteria(
        traj = embedding_matrix,
        part = as.integer(labels),
        crit = "Calinski_Harabasz"
      )$calinski_harabasz
      
      prob_sil <- Silh(model$probability)
      
      saveRDS(
        list(
          model = model,
          Silhouette = avg_sil,
          CH = ch_val,
          ProbSilh = prob_sil,
          k = k_val,
          q = q_val,
          embedding_path = embedding_path
        ),
        cache_file
      )
    }
    
    results_grid$Silhouette[i] <- avg_sil
    results_grid$CH[i] <- ch_val
    results_grid$ProbSilh[i] <- prob_sil
    fpdc_models[[i]] <- model
  }
  
  close(pb)
  
  # Best model: silhouette primary, CH secondary
  best_index <- which.max(results_grid$Silhouette)
  best_params <- results_grid[best_index, ]
  
  best_k <- best_params$k
  best_q <- best_params$q
  best_fpdc <- fpdc_models[[best_index]]
  best_labels <- best_fpdc$label
  
  cluster_df <- data.frame(
    UserID = user_ids,
    Cluster = best_labels
  )
  
  all_results[[embedding_tag]] <- list(
    embedding_path = embedding_path,
    embedding_tag = embedding_tag,
    embedding_matrix = embedding_matrix,
    user_ids = user_ids,
    results_grid = results_grid,
    best_index = best_index,
    best_params = best_params,
    best_k = best_k,
    best_q = best_q,
    best_fpdc = best_fpdc,
    best_labels = best_labels,
    cluster_df = cluster_df,
    dmat = dmat
  )
  
  cat("Finished:", embedding_tag, "\n")
}
```

# 3. Show tuning results

```{r tune}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  cat("\n==========", name, "==========\n")
  print(all_results[[name]]$results_grid)
  cat("\nBest parameters:\n")
  print(all_results[[name]]$best_params)
}
```

# 4. Plot tuning results for each embedding
```{r tune-plots}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  p_sil <- ggplot(res$results_grid, aes(x = q, y = Silhouette, color = factor(k), group = k)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("FPDC Tuning Results (Silhouette) -", name),
      x = "Factor Dimension (q)",
      y = "Average Silhouette Width",
      color = "Clusters (k)"
    )
  
  print(p_sil)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("output/fpdc_plots", paste0("tuning_silhouette_", name, ".png")),
    plot = p_sil,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 120
  )
}

for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  p_ch <- ggplot(res$results_grid, aes(x = q, y = CH, color = factor(k), group = k)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("FPDC Tuning Results (CH) -", name),
      x = "Factor Dimension (q)",
      y = "Calinski-Harabasz Index",
      color = "Clusters (k)"
    )
  
  print(p_ch)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("output/fpdc_plots", paste0("tuning_ch_", name, ".png")),
    plot = p_ch,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 120
  )
}
```

```{r best}
all_best <- lapply(all_results, function(res) {
  data.frame(
    embedding = res$embedding_tag,
    k = res$best_k,
    q = res$best_q,
    Silhouette = res$best_params$Silhouette,
    CH = res$best_params$CH,
    ProbSilh = res$best_params$ProbSilh
  )
})

all_best_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_best)
print(all_best_df)

best_overall_index <- with(all_best_df, order(-Silhouette, -CH))[1]
best_overall <- all_best_df[best_overall_index, ]
print(best_overall)

best_name <- best_overall$embedding
best_res <- all_results[[best_name]]

best_fpdc <- best_res$best_fpdc
best_params <- best_res$best_params
best_k <- best_res$best_k
best_q <- best_res$best_q
best_labels <- best_res$best_labels
cluster_df <- best_res$cluster_df
best_dmat <- best_res$dmat
best_embedding_matrix <- best_res$embedding_matrix
best_results_grid <- best_res$results_grid

```



# 5. PCA plots for best models
```{r}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  pca <- prcomp(res$embedding_matrix)
  
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    Cluster = as.factor(res$best_labels)
  )
  
  p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cluster)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste("FPDC Clusters (PCA Projection) -", name,
                    "k =", res$best_k, ", q =", res$best_q),
      x = "PC1",
      y = "PC2"
    )
  
  print(p_pca)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      "output/fpdc_plots",
      paste0("pca_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".png")
    ),
    plot = p_pca,
    width = 9,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 120
  )
}
```

# 6. Probability silhouette and cluster sizes
```{r prob-sil}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  cat("\n==========", name, "==========\n")
  cat("Best k:", res$best_k, "\n")
  cat("Best q:", res$best_q, "\n")
  cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
  print(table(res$best_labels))
  cat("Probability-based silhouette:\n")
  print(Silh(res$best_fpdc$probability))
}
```

# 7. Save results
```{r save}
for (name in names(all_results)) {
  res <- all_results[[name]]
  
  write.csv(
    res$cluster_df,
    file = file.path(
      "output/fpdc_results",
      paste0("fpdc_clusters_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  write.csv(
    res$results_grid,
    file = file.path(
      "output/fpdc_results",
      paste0("fpdc_tuning_results_", name, ".csv")
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  saveRDS(
    res$best_fpdc,
    file = file.path(
      "output/fpdc_cache",
      paste0("best_fpdc_", name, "_k", res$best_k, "_q", res$best_q, ".rds")
    )
  )
  
  saveRDS(
    res,
    file = file.path(
      "output/fpdc_cache",
      paste0("fpdc_full_result_", name, ".rds")
    )
  )
}

write.csv(
  cluster_df,
  file = file.path(
    "output/fpdc_results",
    paste0("fpdc_best_overall_clusters_", best_name, "_k", best_k, "_q", best_q, ".csv")
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  best_results_grid,
  file = file.path(
    "output/fpdc_results",
    "fpdc_tuning_results_best_overall.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```
